entities.name: Íñigo of Oña
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Íñigo of Oña was the Benedictine abbot of San Salvador at Oña. He was canonised in 1259 by Pope Alexander IV and is venerated in the Roman Catholic Church, where his feast day is 1 June. His feast day is also celebrated on 1 June in the Eastern Orthodox Church. He is the patron saint of Calatayud, his birthplace. Ignatius of Loyola was named after him.
